    Baytowne Big Band

    Friday, September 18, 2026 | 1:30–2:30pm

    Location
    Rotunda at City Hall in Barrie
    Cost
    Free
    Address
    70 Collier St, Barrie, ON L4M 4T5
    Organization
    Baytowne Big Band
    Contact
    Sarang Kulkarni
    Phone
    905-510-0746
    Email
    baytownebigband@gmail.com
    Website URL
    https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1656032573192956&set=a.465614838901408

    As Baytowne is deeply honoured to kick off Culture Days in the Rotunda of City Hall here in Barrie. This year we feature the Sounds of the 1970s. Be sure to come out to hear us play the music of Stevie Wonder, The Average White Band, Jim Croce, Barry Manilow, Billy Joel and others. Our vocalists Janet Ness and Neil Parent have lined up some toe-tapping, dance worthy tunes too!

    If you submitted this event and need details modified on this website, please email AccessBarrieCityInfo@barrie.ca.

    This event listing was submitted to the City's community events calendar using the event submission form and adhered to criteria stipulated within in the form at the time of publishing. Event details may have changed; the website URL listed above may provide different details. 

    September 18, 2026 - 1:30pm - September 18, 2026 - 2:30pm
